title: Riot X Nic Salts Sour Grape Chew 10ml E-Liquid
description: Sour Grape Chew by Riot X delivers a nostalgic blend of sharp Grape and sweet chewy flavour, striking a delicious balance between fruity tang and soft sweetness. The inhale is juicy and tart, followed by a rounded, sweet finish that mimics classic confectionery blends. This e-liquid uses Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine mix — a dual formulation of nicotine salts and freebase — for rapid nicotine satisfaction with a smooth, tactile throat feel. Its 50VG/50PG ratio is tailored for pod kits and MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices, offering discreet vapour with strong flavour delivery. Riot X e-liquids are made in the UK and designed to provide bar salt-style flavour intensity in a reusable, cost-effective 10ml format. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
